Gonadotropin-Releasing Hormone Agonists 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-734191  
Guideline Name 
Gonadotropin-Releasing Hormone Agonists  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
10/14/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Preferred: Fensolvi, Lupron Depot-Ped (1-month): 7.5 mg, 11.25 mg, or 15 mg; 
Non-Preferred: Lupron Depot-Ped 3-Month (11.25mg and 30mg) and 6 month, Triptodur  
Diagnosis 
Central Precocious Puberty (CPP)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of central precocious puberty (idiopathic or neurogenic)  


--- PDF page 727 ---
Page 727 
 
AND 
 
2 - Onset of secondary sexual characteristics in one of the following:  
 
 2.1 Females less than or equal to 8 years of age  
 
OR 
 
 2.2 Males less than or equal to 9 years of age  
 
AND 
 
3 - Confirmation of diagnosis as defined by one of the following:  
 
 3.1 Pubertal basal level of luteinizing hormone (based on laboratory reference ranges)  
 
OR 
 
 3.2 A pubertal luteinizing hormone response to a gonadotropin releasing hormone (GnRH) 
stimulation test  
 
OR 
 
 3.3 Bone age advanced one year beyond the chronological age  
 
AND 
 
4 - For Non-Preferred requests: History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to one of the 
following:  
• 
Fensolvi  
• 
Lupron Depot-Ped (1-month): 7.5 mg, 11.25 mg, or 15 mg  
 


--- PDF page 728 ---
Page 728 
Product Name:Preferred: Fensolvi, Lupron Depot-Ped (1-month): 7.5 mg, 11.25 mg, or 15 mg; 
Non-Preferred: Lupron Depot-Ped 3-Month (11.25mg and 30mg) and 6 month, Triptodur  
Diagnosis 
Central Precocious Puberty (CPP)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Patient is currently receiving therapy for central precocious puberty  
 
AND 
 
2 - Documentation of positive clinical response to therapy  
 
AND 
 
3 - Patient is ONE of the following (younger than the appropriate time point for the onset of 
puberty):  
 
 3.1 Female younger than 11 years of age  
 
OR 
 
 3.2 Male younger than 12 years of age  
 
AND 
 
4 - For Non-Preferred requests, One of the following:  
 
 4.1 For Lupron Depot-Ped (3-Month and 6-Month) requests: Continuation of prior therapy 
(Applies to requests for Lupron Depot-Ped (3-Month and 6-Month) ONLY)  
 
OR 


--- PDF page 729 ---
Page 729 
 
 4.2 History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to one of the following:  
• 
Fensolvi  
• 
Lupron Depot-Ped (1-month): 7.5 mg, 11.25 mg, or 15 mg  
 
Product Name:Preferred: Lupron Depot 3.75 mg; Non-Preferred: Lupron Depot 3-month 
11.25mg  
Diagnosis 
Endometriosis  
Approval Length 
6 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of endometriosis or endometriosis is suspected  
 
AND 
 
2 - One of the following:  
 
 2.1 History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to both of the following:  
 
  2.1.1 Oral contraceptives or depot medroxyprogesterone (e.g., Depo- Provera)  
 
AND 
 
  2.1.2 Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs)  
 
OR 
 
 2.2 Patient has had surgical ablation to prevent recurrence  


--- PDF page 730 ---
Page 730 
 
AND 
 
3 - For Non-Preferred Requests, history of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to Lupron 
Depot 3.75 mg  
 
Product Name:Preferred: Lupron Depot 3.75 mg; Non-Preferred: Lupron Depot 3-month 
11.25mg  
Diagnosis 
Endometriosis  
Approval Length 
6 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of endometriosis or endometriosis is suspected  
 
AND 
 
2 - Recurrence of symptoms following an initial course of therapy  
 
AND 
 
3 - Concurrently to be used with add-back therapy (e.g., progestin, estrogen, or bone sparing 
agents)  
 
AND 
 
4 - For Non-Preferred Requests, history of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to Lupron 
Depot 3.75 mg  
 
Product Name:Preferred: Lupron Depot 3.75 mg; Non-Preferred: Lupron Depot 3-month 
11.25mg  


--- PDF page 731 ---
Page 731 
Diagnosis 
Uterine Leiomyomata (Fibroids)  
Approval Length 
3 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - One of the following:  
 
 1.1 All of the following:  
 
  1.1.1 For the treatment of uterine leiomyomata-related anemia  
 
AND 
 
  1.1.2 Patient did not respond to iron therapy of 1 month duration  
 
AND 
 
  1.1.3 For use prior to surgery  
 
OR 
 
 1.2 For use prior to surgery to reduce the size of fibroids to facilitate a surgical procedure 
(e.g., myomectomy, hysterectomy)  
 
AND 
 
2 - For Non-Preferred Requests, history of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to Lupron 
Depot 3.75 mg  
 
Product Name:Preferred: Fensolvi, Lupron Depot 3.75 mg, Lupron Depot 7.5mg, Lupron 
Depot-Ped (1-month): 7.5 mg, 11.25 mg, or 15 mg; Non-Preferred: Leuprolide acetate inj kit 
5mg/ml, Lupron Depot 3-Month (11.25mg and 22.5mg), 4-Month 30mg, 6-Month 45mg, 
Lutrate Depot, Lupron Depot-Ped 3-Month (11.25mg and 30mg) and 6 month, Triptodur  
Diagnosis 
Gender dysphoria in adolescents less than 19 years old  


--- PDF page 732 ---
Page 732 
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Gonadotropin-Releasing Hormone Agonists used for gender dysphoria in adolescents less 
than 19 years of age are no longer covered under Medicaid and will be denied as benefit 
exclusion. If requested Gonadotropin-Releasing Hormone Agonist was started ON or 
BEFORE October 13, 2026, patient will be grandfathered for 6 months.  
Notes  
Note: Gonadotropin-Releasing Hormone Agonists (e.g., Fensolvi, Lup
ron) used for gender dysphoria in adolescents less than 19 years of a
ge are no longer covered under Medicaid and will be denied as a ben
efit exclusion. If requested Gonadotropin-Releasing Hormone Agonist 
was started ON or BEFORE October 13, 2026, patients will be grandf
athered for 6 months. 
 
Product Name:Preferred: Fensolvi, Lupron Depot 3.75 mg, Lupron Depot 7.5mg, Lupron 
Depot-Ped (1-month): 7.5 mg, 11.25 mg, or 15 mg; Non-Preferred: Leuprolide acetate inj kit 
5mg/ml, Lupron Depot 3-Month (11.25mg and 22.5mg), 4-Month 30mg, 6-Month 45mg, 
Lutrate Depot, Lupron Depot-Ped 3-Month (11.25mg and 30mg) and 6 month, Triptodur  
Diagnosis 
Adjunct for Gender-Affirming Hormonal Therapy for Transgender 
Adults age 19 and older  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Patient is 19 years of age or older  
 
AND 
 
2 - Diagnosis of gender dysphoria, according to the current Diagnostic and Statistical Manual 
of Mental Disorders (i.e., DSM-5) criteria, by a mental health professional  
 
AND 


--- PDF page 733 ---
Page 733 
 
3 - Medication is prescribed by or in consultation with an endocrinologist or a medical provider 
experienced in transgender hormone therapy  
 
AND 
 
4 - Gonads (i.e., testes, ovaries) have not been removed and are functional (e.g., hormone 
producing)  
 
AND 
 
5 - Patient is currently receiving hormonal therapy (e.g., testosterone, estrogens, 
progesterones) to achieve the desired (e.g., non-natal) gender  
 
AND 
 
6 - Inability of cross sex hormone therapy to inhibit natal secondary sex characteristics, 
luteinizing hormone (LH), or gonadotropins (e.g., menses, testosterone)  
 
AND 
 
7 - A letter from the prescriber and/or formal documentation stating all of the following:  
 
 7.1 Transgender patient has identified goals of gender-affirming hormone therapy  
 
AND 
 
 7.2 Coexisting psychiatric and medical comorbidities or social problems that may interfere 
with the diagnostic procedures or treatment have been addressed or removed  
 
AND 
 
 7.3 Both of the following:  
 
  7.3.1 Current enrollment, attendance, and active participation in psychological and social 
support treatment program  


--- PDF page 734 ---
Page 734 
 
AND 
 
  7.3.2 Patient will continue enrollment, attendance and active participation in psychological 
and social support throughout the course of treatment  
 
AND 
 
 7.4 Patient demonstrates knowledge and understanding of the expected outcomes of 
treatment and related transgender therapies  
 
AND 
 
8 - For Non-Preferred requests: History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to one of the 
following:  
• 
Fensolvi  
• 
Lupron Depot 3.75 mg or 7.5mg  
• 
Lupron Depot-Ped (1-month): 7.5 mg, 11.25 mg, or 15 mg  
 
Product Name:Preferred: Fensolvi, Lupron Depot 3.75 mg, Lupron Depot 7.5mg, Lupron 
Depot-Ped (1-month): 7.5 mg, 11.25 mg, or 15 mg; Non-Preferred: Leuprolide acetate inj kit 
5mg/ml, Lupron Depot 3-Month (11.25mg and 22.5mg), 4-Month 30mg, 6-Month 45mg, 
Lutrate Depot, Lupron Depot-Ped 3-Month (11.25mg and 30mg) and 6 month, Triptodur  
Diagnosis 
Adjunct for Gender-Affirming Hormonal Therapy for Transgender 
Adults age 19 and older  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Patient is 19 years of age or older  


--- PDF page 735 ---
Page 735 
 
AND 
 
2 - One of the following:  
• 
Documentation (within the last 6 months) of appropriate luteinizing hormone (LH) 
suppression  
• 
Change in dosing  
 
AND 
 
3 - Documented diagnosis of gender dysphoria, according to the current Diagnostic and 
Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders (i.e., DSM-5) criteria, by a mental health professional  
 
AND 
 
4 - Medication is prescribed by or in consultation with an endocrinologist or a medical provider 
experienced in transgender hormone therapy  
 
AND 
 
5 - Gonads (i.e., testes, ovaries) are intact  
 
AND 
 
6 - Patient is currently receiving hormonal therapy (e.g., testosterone, estrogens, 
progesterones) to achieve the desired (e.g., non-natal) gender  
 
AND 
 
7 - Inability of cross sex hormone therapy to inhibit natal secondary sex characteristics, 
luteinizing hormone (LH), or gonadotropins (e.g., menses, testosterone)  
 
AND 


--- PDF page 736 ---
Page 736 
 
8 - A letter from the prescriber and/or formal documentation stating all of the following:  
 
 8.1 Transgender patient continues to meet goals of gender-affirming hormone therapy  
 
AND 
 
 8.2 Coexisting psychiatric and medical comorbidities or social problems that may interfere 
with the diagnostic procedures or treatment continue to be addressed or removed  
 
AND 
 
 8.3 Both of the following:  
 
  8.3.1 Current enrollment, attendance, and active participation in psychological and social 
support treatment program  
 
AND 
 
  8.3.2 Patient will continue enrollment, attendance and active participation in psychological 
and social support throughout the course of treatment  
 
AND 
 
 8.4 Patient demonstrates knowledge and understanding of the expected outcomes of 
treatment and related transgender therapies  
 
AND 
 
9 - For Non-Preferred requests, One of the following:  
 
 9.1 For Lupron Depot 6-Month and Lupron Depot-Ped (3-Month and 6-Month) requests: 
Continuation of prior therapy [Applies to requests for Lupron Depot 6-Month and Lupron 
Depot-Ped (3-Month and 6-Month) ONLY]  
 
OR 


--- PDF page 737 ---
Page 737 
 
 9.2 History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to one of the following:  
• 
Fensolvi  
• 
Lupron Depot 3.75 mg or 7.5mg  
• 
Lupron Depot-Ped (1-month): 7.5 mg, 11.25 mg, or 15 mg  
 
Product Name:Preferred: Fensolvi, Lupron Depot 3.75 mg, Lupron Depot 7.5mg, Lupron 
Depot-Ped (1-month): 7.5 mg, 11.25 mg, or 15 mg; Non-Preferred: Leuprolide acetate inj kit 
5mg/ml, Lupron Depot 3-Month (11.25mg and 22.5mg), 4-Month 30mg, 6-Month 45mg, 
Lutrate Depot, Lupron Depot-Ped 3-Month (11.25mg and 30mg) and 6 month, Triptodur  
Diagnosis 
Fertility Preservation  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - For use in pre-menopausal women  
 
AND 
 
2 - Patient is receiving a cytotoxic agent that is associated with causing primary ovarian 
insufficiency (premature ovarian failure) [e.g., Cytoxan (cyclophosphamide), procarbazine, 
vinblastine, cisplatin]  
 
AND 
 
3 - For Non-Preferred requests: History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to one of the 
following:  
• 
Fensolvi  
• 
Lupron Depot 3.75 mg or 7.5mg  
• 
Lupron Depot-Ped (1-month): 7.5 mg, 11.25 mg, or 15 mg

Product Name:Preferred: Fensolvi, Lupron Depot 3.75 mg, Lupron Depot 7.5mg, Lupron 
Depot-Ped (1-month): 7.5 mg, 11.25 mg, or 15 mg; Non-Preferred: Leuprolide acetate inj kit 
5mg/ml, Lupron Depot 3-Month (11.25mg and 22.5mg), 4-Month 30mg, 6-Month 45mg, 
Lutrate Depot, Lupron Depot-Ped 3-Month (11.25mg and 30mg) and 6 month, Triptodur  
Diagnosis 
Fertility Preservation  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Patient is currently receiving gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) analog therapy for 
the purpose of fertility preservation  
 
AND 
 
2 - Patient continues to receive a cytotoxic agent that is associated with causing primary 
ovarian insufficiency (premature ovarian failure) [e.g., Cytoxan (cyclophosphamide), 
procarbazine, vinblastine, cisplatin]  
 
AND 
 
3 - For Non-Preferred requests, One of the following:  
 
 3.1 For Lupron Depot 6-Month and Lupron Depot-Ped (3-Month and 6-Month) requests: 
Continuation of prior therapy [Applies to requests for Lupron Depot 6-Month and Lupron 
Depot-Ped (3-Month and 6-Month) ONLY]  
 
OR 
 
 3.2 History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to one of the following:  
• 
Fensolvi  
• 
Lupron Depot 3.75 mg or 7.5mg  
• 
Lupron Depot-Ped (1-month): 7.5 mg, 11.25 mg, or 15 mg

Lupron Depot 7.5mg
